title: NNSA capacity hold: current two-site policy still does not establish final accepted operating capacity
summary: The current two-site program description and draft PEIS alternatives do not supply a final decision, installed and accepted capacity, readiness authorization, or recurring qualified output. Denominator: The final decision, installed equipment, acceptance evidence, readiness authorization, and recurring output at Los Alamos and Savannah River as separate stages.
key_findings: Evidence stage: Qualified output outcome hold.
